definition: to shine in short bright bursts
description: At night in a storm, a white lighthouse with dark bands stands at the end of a stone harbour pier. Its lamp shines a bright starburst of light, goes dark while a huge wave crashes against the rocks and throws white spray high into the air, and then shines brightly again. A small light on a marker in the water blinks once. Water pours off the pier as the wave falls back. Dark water churns around the harbour, the masts of small boats poke up below, and a coiled rope lies on a bollard.

taps.phrase: to send out a powerful beam
to lie coiled on the pier
